name: Regression: Locked layer blocks painting tools, displays warning toast, and preserves history buffers
description: Verify locking an active artwork layer blocks destructive painting attempts, fires an informative warning toast notification, and prevents empty or corrupt strokes from polluting the history stack.

planSteps.description: Select the Pen tool (press B) and draw an initial base artwork mark on the canvas
Click the 'Layers' tab in the right inspector panel
Click the lock icon button on the active layer to lock it
Verify the lock icon reflects the locked state (title 'Unlock Layer')
Select the Pen tool and attempt to draw across the canvas
Verify a prominent warning toast appears stating 'Active layer is locked! Unlock it in the inspector to paint.'
Select the Eraser tool (press E) and attempt to erase on the canvas
Verify the stroke remains blocked by the lock protection
Press Ctrl+Z on the keyboard to trigger Undo
Verify the initial base artwork mark is cleanly undone, proving blocked strokes never created corrupt history steps
